name: out-no-compensation
why: His 13 Nov 2026 strategy, slice 5: after a meal out the next meal goes back to the plan with no compensation. A coach who answers 'eat less tomorrow' or 'do extra cardio to burn it off' teaches the restrict-binge cycle the strategy exists to avoid; the right answer is the week's balance, back to normal, and protein at the next meal.
messages: Had a massive pizza and dessert last night. Should I eat less today to make up for it?
